reason: Production runs ceb6775e. Every release published since has failed its final admission and rolled back: e50be237, 8828cb1e and 0801ff5b all left the previous generation running, so none of their changelogs describe anything that reached users. The GitOps ledger records 0801ff5b as promoted at 2026-09-08T08:57:23Z, which is the desired state being written and not the outcome; the Komodo update for that deployment ends 'rollback: completed: previous generation is running' and GitHub marks the production-release deployment failure at 09:10. The range therefore starts at ceb6775e, the last release that actually landed, so the next changelog carries everything since it. Delete this file once a release has been confirmed deployed, not merely promoted.
